purpose: Audit how the selected fixed-target one-electron H+ + H(1s) TDL/AOCC research repository developed from its R3M10 imported checkpoint through R3M29, preserving run provenance, first failures, scientific claim ceilings, and backup/readback distinctions.
desired_audit_result: An independent, evidence-linked assessment of implementation/run integrity, numerical gate history, preserved failures, claim scope, and remaining blockers, ending with one justified next action. The audit must not promote production from a local reference or pair screen alone.

report_compilation.authorization: owner-directed Host documentation and inventory only

scientific_scope.target: Numerically faithful selected physical model; all-bound capture cross sections at 50/100/225 keV/u are the project objective. Literature/private raw agreement is not prerequisite.

milestones.title: Repository intake
milestones.recorded_outcome: Imported manifest-verified independent physical-problem checkpoint; repository root commit.

milestones.title: Single-b baseline and controlled variables
milestones.recorded_outcome: Recorded imported scientific NO_GO and separated fixed-CAP/finite-span controls.

milestones.title: Controlled single-b return
milestones.recorded_outcome: Added controlled comparisons and preserved the NO_GO decision and publication failures/receipts.

milestones.title: Preparation diagnostics
milestones.recorded_outcome: Added conditional preparation-pair diagnostics and transfer bounds; no new production collision or cross section.

milestones.title: Preparation-pair gate and collision
milestones.recorded_outcome: Preparation-pair NO_GO; collision comparison passed only as a pair screen. Production remains NO_GO.

milestones.title: Controlled spatial matrix
milestones.recorded_outcome: Three A/B/C collisions and preparation controls recorded; scientific convergence NO_GO.

milestones.title: Coulomb/FFT h-dt study
milestones.recorded_outcome: Two A1/B1 collisions and target-only diagnostics; time refinement remained open.

milestones.title: Production validation infrastructure
milestones.recorded_outcome: Added independent time reference, immutable checkpoint handling and execution contracts; production HOLD.

milestones.title: B2 temporal refinement
milestones.recorded_outcome: Recorded B2 and channel changes exceeding the 0.10% screen; temporal gate remained open.

milestones.title: Full-H diagnostics and work precision
milestones.recorded_outcome: Time refinement remained open; bounded full-H diagnostics and CPU performance candidates were recorded.

milestones.title: Short-window GPU reference/work precision
milestones.recorded_outcome: Ran bounded diagnostics on retained B2 checkpoints; scope remained local Strang reference, not production.

milestones.title: Incoming CF4 reference resolution attempt
milestones.recorded_outcome: Incoming B2 CPU/GPU reference ladder did not satisfy its strict oracle gate; first failure retained.

milestones.title: Incoming full-H inner action reference
milestones.recorded_outcome: Bounded GPU reference retry and strict CPU oracle evidence; unresolved historical failures retained.

milestones.title: Closest/outgoing B2 cross-window work precision
milestones.recorded_outcome: Two retained-window comparisons passed only for REFERENCE_FOR_STRANG; no global time or production promotion.

milestones.title: Local integration and bounded reference
milestones.recorded_outcome: Local integration suite and two B2 windows; typed result scope remained REFERENCE_FOR_STRANG.

milestones.title: Physical t=0 event window
milestones.recorded_outcome: Four-step local event window passed its local CF4/Strang-scale checks; no global time certificate.

milestones.title: Model foundation and prospective convergence strategy
milestones.recorded_outcome: Completed model/units/observable and prospective numerical criteria; production remains HOLD.

milestones.title: B3 full collision and frozen time estimate
milestones.recorded_outcome: One preparation and one witnessed 7172-step B3 collision; fixed-h selected-span temporal estimate validated, noncertified.

milestones.title: A3 same-horizon spatial pair
milestones.recorded_outcome: One preparation and one witnessed 7172-step A3 collision; P1-P3 pair screen NO_GO at 3.03-3.29%; continuum spatial error remains open.

milestones.title: Point-Coulomb cell and phase discriminator
milestones.recorded_outcome: Local singular-cell bias and production-order phase histogram prioritized cell-average as a short-window candidate; causality and production spatial budget remain open.

backup_semantics: Every listed local Dropbox file is linked by absolute local path. File presence/size does not prove remote restore. Follow the linked receipt per backup and retain RESTORE_NOT_TESTED or NOT_RUN exactly as recorded.
execution_policy_for_auditor: Read the local repository and all linked actual run result files before conclusions.
Do not rerun full collisions, preparations, finer h, b-grid, physical rates, or overwrite evidence.
Do not treat paired raw differences, local windows, completed jobs, reviewer passes, or backup upload receipts as production admission.
Preserve original failure logs and distinguish runtime/environment failures from scientific NO_GO.
Cite every finding to a linked exact file and state what was not tested.
